decisions.reason: Because it is a close extension of the firm's core pipe-related fabrication offer, uses existing capabilities, and was publicly committed to with its own page, management is likely to continue backing it and explain any weakness as temporary project-driven demand variation.

This product fits the established technical base and the stated strategy of broadening tailored infrastructure components, so prior investment and visible commitment make withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Although the firm has some fabrication and coating know-how behind it, this single-model public waste bin is comparatively distant from the core business and less central than the other new lines, making it the easiest product to sacrifice while concentrating resources elsewhere.

As a multi-model product line with a dedicated page, it reflects stronger sunk investment and public commitment, and management can justify continued persistence by linking it to the firm's coating and custom-fabrication capabilities.

Despite being outside the core pipeline range, the multi-model ashtray line uses related metalworking and coating resources and carries enough visible commitment that management is likely to keep it while attributing any disappointing results to slow market development.
